title: How much tax will your bonus pay? #BonusTax
text:
Find your marginal rate: take your monthly salary before tax, multiply it by 12, and find the step it lands in (2026/27 tax year). Up to R245,100 a year: 18%. Up to R383,100: 26%. Up to R530,200: 31%. That's roughly the bite tax will take out of your bonus, before you even see it.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
- SARS, rates of tax for individuals (2027 tax year): https://www.sars.gov.za/tax-rates/income-tax/rates-of-tax-for-individuals/
